jobs.description:
Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Veo you will get to work on challenging problems and directly contribute to the value created by our AI-driven end-user products.

You will become part of our AI team, which comprises 20+ researchers and engineers responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across different projects - from scoping and defining data annotation tasks to modeling, validation, and deployment. You will take ownership of the direction and execution of your projects while collaborating closely with the rest of the team, exchanging feedback, and helping others improve and succeed.

We stay current with the latest research and continuously discuss concepts and ideas in recent papers to assess their relevance to our tasks and product-specific challenges.

We are looking for an ambitious, high-performing senior engineer or researcher with a strong track record of delivering real-world machine learning systems. You should bring the technical depth and judgment needed to make sound decisions in complex and sometimes ambiguous environments.

**What you will do:

**

• Train state-of-the-art machine learning models

• Write efficient inference pipelines for cloud and edge

• Define and supervise data annotation tasks

• Improve evaluation schemes to increase understanding of model performance and shortcomings

• Contribute to long-term planning and prioritization of tasks

• Mentor colleagues and raise the technical bar through feedback, knowledge sharing, and collaboration

**What you could bring:

**

• MSc or PhD in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience

• Extensive hands-on experience delivering real-world, large-scale machine learning projects

• Strong coding and software engineering skills, with experience building maintainable production systems

• Experience taking ownership of technically complex projects from concept to deployment

• Sound technical judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguity and balance research, product, and engineering considerations

• A rigorous and critical approach to examining details, assumptions, and results

• Strong communication skills and the ability to influence technical direction across teams

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

jobs.description:
Do you want to work for some of the world’s leading audio brands? Become a part of the HARMAN team and get to work for JBL and Harman/Kardon.

By joining HARMAN, you'll dive headfirst into the exciting world of headphones, portable speakers, party boxes and other audio technologies, and contribute to the success of Harman Lifestyle EMEA business. The consumer audio industry is fast paced, fun and dynamic and we’re looking for someone who is proactive, loves to work with a lot of different stakeholders from all over Europe and has creative ideas.

You will join our new Acoustics Engineering Lab within Harman Consumer Audio, based in Kvistgaard, Denmark in the position of:

Engineer New Technology & Innovation - Acoustic Measurement & Evaluation

Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle:

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.

• Contribute your talents to high-end, esteemed brands like JBL, Harman Kardon, Mark Levinson and Revel.

• Unite your passion for audio innovation with high-tech product development.

• Create pitch-perfect, cutting-edge technology that elevates listening experience.

HARMAN’s engineers and designers are creative, purposeful and agile. As part of this team, you’ll combine your technical expertise with innovative ideas to help drive cutting-edge solutions in the consumer audio systems. Every day, you will push the boundaries of creative design, and HARMAN is committed to providing you with the opportunities, innovative technologies and resources to build a successful career.

What You’ll Be Part Of

The Consumer Audio New Technology & Innovation (NT&I) team is at the center of audio technology innovation, supporting the development of HARMAN's next-generation consumer audio products, including over-ear headphones, true wireless stereo (TWS) earbuds, and open wireless stereo (OWS) devices. The NT&I Denmark team is seeking a Senior Engineer, Acoustic Measurement & Evaluation, to lead the development, execution, and continuous improvement of acoustic measurement and subjective evaluation methodologies for consumer audio products.

The successful candidate will be responsible for objective acoustic characterization of loudspeakers, headphones, earbuds, and emerging audio devices, as well as the design and management of laboratory test environments and listening evaluation programs.

This role combines deep expertise in electroacoustic measurements, data analysis, listening science, and laboratory operations to ensure industry-leading audio performance across our product portfolio.

How You’ll Make An Impact:

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical leadership in acoustic measurement and evaluation, establishing best practices, and driving continuous improvement of measurement capabilities, tools, and processes.

• Acoustic Measurement & Characterization: Lead the objective acoustic characterization of speakers, headphones, earbuds, and emerging audio products, utilizing advanced measurement techniques to assess frequency response, distortion, directivity, sensitivity, noise performance, and sound pressure capabilities.

• Subjective Evaluation & Listening Science: Design and conduct subjective listening evaluations, including listener panel management, competitive benchmarking, and the development of scientifically robust methodologies for assessing sound quality and user experience.

• Data Analysis & Performance Insights: Analyse and interpret objective and subjective performance data, generating actionable insights and developing meaningful correlations between acoustic measurements and listener preferences.

• Measurement Methodology & Standards: Develop, validate, and maintain measurement methodologies and standards, ensuring acoustic evaluations are accurate, repeatable, and aligned across development teams and laboratories.

• Acoustic Laboratory Development: Design, establish, and maintain state-of-the-art acoustic test facilities, including listening rooms, anechoic and semi-anechoic environments, ear-simulator and HATS-based measurement systems, and automated test platforms.

• Collaboration: Provide acoustic measurement and evaluation support for internally developed technologies, algorithms, and proof-of-concept systems, and collaborate with cross-functional teams on product validation, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and deployment.

What Makes You A Strong Fit:

Education & Experience:

• M.S. or Ph.D. in Acoustics, Audio Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Physics, or a related field.

• At least 8 years of experience in acoustic measurement, audio product development, electroacoustic testing, or acoustic research.

• Demonstrated experience leading technical initiatives and driving improvements in measurement methodologies, laboratory capabilities, or audio evaluation processes.

Technical Skills:

• Strong expertise in objective acoustic measurement and characterization of speakers, headphones, earbuds, and related audio systems, including frequency response, distortion, directivity, sensitivity, noise, and SPL performance.

• Deep understanding of psychoacoustics, listening science, and subjective evaluation methodologies (e.g., MUSHRA test) including statistical analysis.

• Hands-on experience with industry-standard tools such as Audio Precision APx, SoundCheck, ear simulators, and precision measurement microphones (e.g., from Brüel & Kjær, GRAS).

• Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for measurement automation, signal processing, data analysis, and visualization.

Bonus Points if You Have:

• Experience with active noise control, headphone hear-through, spatial audio, noise reduction, AI-based audio processing, and other advanced audio technologies.

• Experience applying AI and data-driven approaches to acoustic evaluation, listening-test analysis, perceptual modelling, or measurement automation.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively within and across teams.

• Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of driving projects with a high degree of ownership.

• Passion for audio quality, innovation, and continuous learning.

Things To Know:

• This position collaborates with global teams, and occasional early-morning or evening meetings may be required to work with colleagues in China and the United States.

• Occasional international travel to other HARMAN sites is required.

• Professional working proficiency in English is required for effective day-to-day communication with regional engineering teams.

What You Can Expect:

• Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others).

• Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

**The Opportunity

**Veo's security surface is unusual. We train models on-premise on dedicated GPU infrastructure, run the product across AWS and GCP, and operate a fleet of tens of thousands of cameras deployed at clubs and venues worldwide. That is a scope most SaaS security engineers never touch: physical devices in the field, heavy on-prem compute, and multi-cloud production, all in one role.

We are forming a Security Enablement Team that makes it easier for every engineering and IT team at Veo to build, ship, and operate secure systems. As the most senior engineer on the team, you will own the technical direction of the platform security, identity, and network security slice, partnering with the teams that own these systems so security is built in from the start. As an enablement function, the team does not run these systems day to day. We build the paved roads, tooling, and patterns that let the owning teams operate securely by default.

You will join during a pivotal moment. We are standing the team up, defining what good looks like across platform security, identity, and network security, and rolling out the first paved roads for image scanning, SBOM generation, CVE response, CI/CD identity, and a unified internal network across our datacenters (GCP, AWS) and offices (Miami, Berlin, and Copenhagen). You'll have direct impact on how 100+ engineers write, review and ship secure systems.

**What You Will Do

**You will join a focused platform security team and operate as its most senior engineer. Everything below follows the same pattern. We design the paved road, prove it works, and hand it to the team that will own it. We share ownership, pair on complex work, and rotate responsibilities, and we expect this role to set the bar.

• Design and build the paved roads for image scanning, SBOM generation, and CVE response, running inside the pipelines teams already use, with findings routed to the owners who can fix them under tracked SLAs

• Lead the design, reviews, and tooling for a unified internal network and VPN across GCP, AWS, and our Miami, Berlin, and Copenhagen offices, while the team that owns the network keeps running it

• Work with the auth service maintainers on identity and access, including MFA rollouts, removal of shared accounts, and cleanup of long-lived tokens, so the patterns stay theirs to own

• Make workload identity the paved road for CI/CD, using OIDC between GitHub Actions and AWS or GCP, packaged so teams can migrate themselves

• Build audit logging as a shared capability that teams plug into rather than reinvent

• Turn GRC controls into technical implementations, with evidence pipelines that produce auditable output without manual follow-up

• Own the contracting cycle for external penetration tests and build the intake, classification, and tracking system that routes findings to named owners, while the owning teams remediate

As the team matures, you will help shape our multi-environment network architecture, our identity and access patterns, and the long-term security posture of the product.

**What You Could Bring

**This is a deliberately merged platform security and identity role. You do not need to be world class at both. You likely have several years of production infrastructure and security experience behind you, and you are deep and credible in one of these areas and ready to grow into the other.

That depth tends to show up in several of the following:

• Platform security: you have run vulnerability scanning, CVE management, and image scanning at scale, and you know the operational reality of getting CVEs fixed, beyond standing up the tooling

• Identity and auth: you have worked hands-on inside an auth codebase, rolled out MFA on live systems, and managed token lifecycles in CI/CD with OIDC and workload identity

• Network security at scale: you have designed and run a unified internal network across multiple cloud providers and offices, with a VPN approach that holds up

• Platform-as-product mindset: you have built internal security tooling that other teams chose to adopt, with guard rails built into the tools developers already use and manual review as a last resort, and you gathered feedback and measured the impact

• Infrastructure as Code: strong experience with Terraform, Crossplane, or similar

Nice to have: GitOps tools such as Flux or ArgoCD, Cilium, Kubernetes security at scale, and experience building security into a GRC evidence pipeline.

**How We Work

**You'll join a Copenhagen-based Security Enablement Team of three engineers plus a manager. We operate as an enablement function: we build shared tooling and golden paths, and we step in for focused, high-leverage missions where no other team is positioned to deliver. We do not run a SOC and we do not carry a security pager.

You'll collaborate regularly with the Platform, Product, IT, Firmware, and GRC teams. We work pragmatically and iterate quickly. This role sets the technical direction for the team's quarterly missions. We document decisions, favor simple solutions where possible, and focus on tooling and platform patterns that help teams move faster with confidence.

If you read that list and matched on three or four items but not all of them, apply anyway. The "deep in one, ready to grow into the other" framing above is not a hedge, it is how we actually hire at this level. We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

**About The Role

• Designing and implementing infrastructure, automation, and internal tooling

• Writing, reviewing, debugging, and optimising production code

• Working with developers to improve how systems are built, deployed, and operated

• Responding to incidents when needed, then making sure the underlying problem is permanently addressed

• Exploring how new technologies and AI-powered tools can improve our engineering workflow

• Thinking proactively about scaling, capacity, resilience, and potential failure scenarios

AI is part of the job

We’re an AI-first company. AI and agentic coding are already part of how we build, investigate, automate, and improve systems.

You should already be comfortable using AI in your daily engineering workflow—for example, to investigate incidents, generate and review code, build internal tooling, automate operational work, and improve your own productivity.

How we work

This role can be fully remote for the right person.

We believe in giving people the freedom to structure their work in a way that helps them perform at their best. We care about impact, ownership, communication, and results—not about watching when or where you work.

You’ll need to work with meaningful overlap during CET working hours and participate in our PagerDuty/on-call rotation. Freedom comes with responsibility, especially when you are responsible for production systems.

On-call includes holidays

If you are scheduled to be on call and a genuine production alarm goes off—whether that is on a normal weekday, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year’s Eve, or New Year’s Day—you are expected to respond, take ownership, and stay with the issue until our systems are fully up and running again.

This is an important part of the role and is not optional. We are looking for someone who genuinely stands behind their work and understands that production ownership sometimes means being there when things go wrong.

At the same time, your goal is to make this situation as rare as possible. The best engineer is not the person who enjoys firefighting every holiday, but the person who builds reliable systems, strong monitoring, and effective automation so that firefighting is never needed.

How to apply

Instead of starting with a traditional cover letter, please send us a maximum 10-minute video.

We are hiring a human being—not AI-generated slop, a spotless resume, or someone who simply knows how to present the right keywords. We know the kind of person we are looking for, but the process also needs to be mutual. You should get the opportunity to meet the people behind the company and decide whether this is the right environment for you.

That is why we want to meet you upfront and see how you think, communicate, and explain your experience—not only evaluate what is written on paper.

**In The Video, Please Tell Us

**

• Who you are

• The production systems you have owned

• A difficult reliability or performance problem you solved

• What you changed and the measurable result

• How you approach incidents and on-call responsibility

• How you currently use AI and agentic coding

• Why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role

• What you are looking for in your next team and role

The video does not need to be polished. Please don’t spend time producing a perfect presentation or reading a script. We want to see the real person, understand how you think, and hear about the work you have actually done.

You may also include a short written example of a system that was slow, unreliable, or difficult to operate. Explain how you found the root cause, what you changed, and what improved afterwards.

If you are primarily an infrastructure administrator, this probably isn’t the right role. If you are a production-minded software engineer who enjoys making systems faster, more reliable, and easier to operate, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: PhD Stipend in clinical metagenomics for neonatal sepsis diagnostics
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an opportunity to contribute to the development of novel infectious disease diagnostics? And do you want be part of an established interdisciplinary team with expertise from patient bed to lab bench? If yes, we look forward to reading your application to our PhD Stipend.

At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, Department of Chemistry and Bioscience, a Ph.D. stipend is available within the general study program. The PhD stipend is open for appointment from 1st of April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is for 3 years, and the workplace is in Aalborg, Denmark.

**Your work tasks
**The work of the PhD candidate is multifaceted. The candidate will develop on a metagenomic assay to enable the detection of RNA viruses from cell-free nucleic acid material from plasma samples. Furthermore, we will build a reference database of genomes for selected pathogens isolated from neonates and use this – in collaboration with project-associated physicians – to understand if genomic signatures can be used to predict clinical outcomes. Finally, we will analyse plasma samples from a prospective cohort of neonates with sepsis – inclusion has passed 200 neonates already – to determine the feasibility of using metagenomics in this patient indication based on comparison to state-of-the-art microbiological methods.

The work will be carried out in an interdisciplinary research group of neonatal physicians, clinical microbiologists, molecular biologists, and bioinformaticians.

Your competencies The ideal candidate has a Master’s degree focused on molecular biology and/or bioinformatics. The candidate should have significant experience analyzing metagenomic data and working on HPC systems. Excellent oral and written English language skills are a requirement. The applicant must thrive working in an interdisciplinary research environment.

**Qualification requirements
**PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at  the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are

At the Department of Chemistry and Bioscience (BIO), our high-level research spans from basic to applied within both natural sciences and engineering. With approx. 150 employees, 75 PhD students, and 775 bachelor and master’s students at our campuses in Aalborg (main campus) and Esbjerg, we are a vital research and educational institution when it comes to creating new basic knowledge as well as contributing to solving the world’s challenges within biology, chemistry, biotechnology, bioengineering, environmental science, and chemical engineering.

We continuously improve our department as an attractive place of work and study. We offer flexible hours, social activities throughout the year both at the department level and in each Section. We are inclusive and have respect for individuals, communities, and cultures. Our work culture is founded on openness, curiosity, transparency, and involvement. Come join us!

Read more about the department here; Welcome to the Department of Chemistry and Bioscience - en.bio.aau.dk - Aalborg University

**How to apply
**Your application must include the following:

• 
Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position

• 
Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• 
Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades)

• 
Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

**Salary and terms of employment
**The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement).

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

A property manager can handle 600 tenants. That's the industry limit. Why? Because the work scales linearly: matching bank transactions to invoices, chasing late payments, answering tenant questions, coordinating repairs, preparing legal notices, renewing leases. More tenants, more of the same manual work.

With AI, that limit disappears. And both landlords and tenants get a better experience.

**About Rumli

**Eight years in property operations. ~1,000 customers across Denmark, the Netherlands, and Germany. We know this industry: the workflows, the pain points, the regulations.

Now we're making a big move: becoming a property manager. Tenant communication, bookkeeping, coordinating repairs. We handle it all. A landlord shouldn't chase late payments or find a plumber at 10 pm. We do it for them.

We're building an entirely new platform to power this. AI-native from day one. Profitable, real customers, expanding across the Nordics.

**Why this is interesting

**Property management is a great domain for a product engineer. Thousands of similar transactions, pattern-based decisions, templated documents. And 1,000 customers who will tell you exactly where it hurts. Years of domain knowledge, ready to turn into a product.

We ship with AI agents built into the workflow. Our codebase has custom skills to improve our workflow. AI writes a lot of the code; we review it. That means the slow part of building isn't writing code anymore. It's knowing what to build. That's what this role is about.

**The role

**You are autonomous and independent, working with the team to solve property managers' pains and make them as efficient as possible.

• Talk to customers and property managers. Find out what actually slows them down

• Decide what to build, then build it. Mockup, prototype, ship, measure, repeat

• Own features end-to-end. Database to API to UI

• Build AI into core product features

• Work directly with our co-founder on product direction

We need someone who looks at a messy problem and figures out what to build, and doesn't wait for a spec.

**Tech stack

**TypeScript everywhere. But does it even matter anymore?

• Frontend: Next.js, React, Shadcn, Tailwind CSS

• Backend: NestJS, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM

• Infra: AWS Lambda, CDK, RDS, EventBridge, SQS

**What We're Looking For

**

• Product thinking. You understand what it takes to build a profitable product. You are not here just to handle tickets.

• Strong product mindset. Agents can code, but they need scoping and steering.

• You've shipped things people actually use, and you can show them.

• Comfortable talking to customers.

• Experience with coding agents.

• Work independently.

• Copenhagen-based (on-site).

Big plus: AWS, AI experience (prompt engineering, RAG, agents), fintech/proptech background, a side project you're proud of.

**Compensation & Benefits

**

• Compensation: 50–65K DKK, depending on experience and demonstrated competencies

• Equity: Employee warrants offering real ownership in the company

• Workspace: Centrally located Copenhagen office

• Perks: Daily lunch included

**Why Rumli?

**Real customers. Brand-new codebase. Small team where your decisions matter.

We're rebuilding from the ground up with AI as the foundation. If you want to decide what property software should do, not just build what someone else specified, reach out.

**The Impact You'll Make

**Are you a Senior Software Engineer with experience in embedded Linux systems development? We are looking for an experienced professional to join our international R&D team. Your primary mission will be to develop one of our most successful products, an edge controller that connects and manages embedded systems in food retail applications.

The Development team is part of the Commercial Compressor Electronics group within Danfoss Climate Solutions - a leading supplier to the refrigeration and air conditioning industries. We develop and produce sustainable and quality solutions for people around the world and have a positive impact on global change. You will be part of a diverse, multi-cultural and multi-national team with an open mindset where communication is transparent and feedback is encouraged.

This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy working on high-complexity embedded systems. You will be a key driver for the evolution of our System Manager Edge controller, codriving architectural choices, new features developments and software restructuring to elevate our solution to new standards.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**Your primary responsibilities will include daily tasks such as designing, maintaining, and improving sub-systems and modules, and implementing them using C/C++. You will also work with Python for automated testing.

You will cooperate closely with your colleagues from other DevOps teams, ensuring that applications and/or systems meet customer requirements using open standards.

**More Specifically, You Will

**

• Collaborate with technical lead on architectural choices.

• Design, code, and integrate software for embedded Linux targets, including developing systems based on ARM MPU/MCU multi-core architectures and interacting with the Linux kernel and Yocto framework.

• Improve and maintain existing software components and ensure the software is up to date with the latest technologies.

• Participate in peer reviews to ensure a high level of quality in the products.

• Collaborate with external partners, including consultants, customers, and IT departments.

• Be involved in platform-based development for synergy with other products and ensure product security.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Educational Background in Computer Science or a related field is preferred.

• Over 6 years of experience in similar roles, gained in medium-sized multinational environments.

• More than 3 years of experience with software running on Linux, including deep knowledge of embedded Linux, secure bootloaders, and multi-processor/multi-core systems.

• Experience in architecture of SCADA/BMS systems.

• Excellent proficiency in coding with C/C++.

• Hands-on experience in developing, reviewing, and debugging libraries, and communication drivers (e.g., MQTT, Wi-Fi, Modbus RTU/IP. BACNet).

• Familiarity with small-scale embedded graphical libraries (e.g. LVGL, Qt for embedded, emWin)

• Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, resilient, and secure products.

• Experience in collaborating with external design houses and working in a multicultural environment.

• Excellent proficiency in English, both verbal and written; knowledge of Danish and/or Italian is a plus.

• Strong analytical skills, a positive attitude towards cross-border and cross-cultural cooperation, and clear, concise communication of technical and business matters complete the profile.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

The compensation package includes base salary, performance-based incentive, and benefits. Salary range and full details will be shared at first contact and will reflect candidate location, local market conditions, and applicable local pay transparency regulations.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

jobs.description:
_Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

_Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement—replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

As our new Senior Software Engineer — Wealth Management Systems 📈

You will help the team solve some of the hardest product and data problems across Performativ’s investment platform.

You will work where financial workflows, product decisions, and technical systems meet: portfolio data, reporting, fees, reconciliation, instruments, transactions, cash, performance, and trading. Your contribution will be turning that complexity into coherent solutions that work across customers rather than becoming a collection of one-off customisations.

This is not a narrowly scoped position. We work as one team, and you should be willing to tackle any important problem within our area.

• You will apply deep experience from wealth management, asset management, private banking, portfolio management, investment operations, trading, custody, or related financial infrastructure to develop sound product and system designs.

• You will investigate problems that cross financial data, calculations, APIs, integrations, operational processes, and production systems—determining their root causes and delivering reliable solutions that others can understand and extend.

• You will bring product thinking to ambiguous requirements, working closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to distinguish reusable platform needs from customer-specific preferences.

• You will use AI agents to produce much of the implementation. We expect you to design the solution, direct agents effectively, challenge their assumptions, review their output, and establish the tests and evidence needed for safe production deployment.

• You will lead when your knowledge makes you the right person to lead, follow through on what you take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

Experience with performance calculations, valuations, fees, reporting, reconciliation, corporate actions, or portfolio-management systems would be particularly valuable.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. Autonomy works only when paired with initiative, collaboration, sound judgment, and follow-through.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be technically strong enough to recognise weak abstractions, incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, security problems, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

• Trust and meaningful responsibility from your first day, with the opportunity to influence both our platform and how we build it.

• Difficult and consequential problems involving financial data, product design, reliability, security, and real operational workflows.

• The opportunity to define an AI-native approach to developing complex financial software and see your work reach customers quickly.

• An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows into a European market leader.

Join TICRA in a newly established role and plan, coordinate, and drive software releases and major external projects across technical, product, and commercial functions.

Create clarity and predictability in complex delivery

As Project and Release Manager, you will join TICRA's Engineering Excellence domain and report to the Domain Lead. You will coordinate TICRA Tools software releases and manage major external projects, including offset programmes and larger ESA activities, from initial planning through delivery and closure. Maintaining an integrated overview of scope, timelines, budgets, risks, dependencies, and specialist capacity, you will translate product priorities and contractual commitments into realistic plans with clear milestones, responsibilities, and reporting. Working closely with Product Managers, technical leads, commercial functions, and other key stakeholders, you will create clarity around ownership and release readiness, drive timely decisions, and escalate when scope, resources, and timelines do not align. You will also strengthen TICRA's project and release practices through pragmatic structures, transparent reporting, and effective use of tools such as Jira and TimeLog, contributing to more predictable delivery.

Experienced Project Manager who thrives in a technical environment

You have a relevant background in engineering, IT, business, or a related field, combined with experience managing complex technical or software development projects across disciplines and functions. You are familiar with software release planning, product delivery, or similar development environments and comfortable managing multiple projects or commitments in parallel. Strong project management capabilities and sufficient technical understanding enable you to identify dependencies and risks in collaboration with the company's specialists. The position is permanent and based at TICRA's office in Copenhagen. English is the working language, and Danish is not required.

You are structured and pragmatic, with the confidence to create progress among highly specialized professionals. You communicate clearly, build trust across functions, and challenge unclear commitments, unrealistic plans, and unresolved ownership in a constructive way. Through dialogue, clear expectations, and timely escalation, you create accountability while respecting the expertise and decision-making authority of relevant specialists. You thrive on combining hands-on project management with the development of stronger ways of working in a complex technical environment.

Shape the future of connectivity and defense

This is your opportunity to join TICRA as it strengthens its global position in advanced antenna simulation and expands its commercial footprint. The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search (www.venaris.dk). For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Head of Research, Sofie Rudbech Mathisen, at +45 2512 1162. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV (in PDF format) – it is not necessary to include a cover letter.

TICRA

TICRA develops and sells highly specialized software for designing and analyzing antenna systems used in satellites, advanced communication systems, and defense applications, complemented by related engineering services. Headquartered in Copenhagen, the company serves engineers and scientists worldwide. Since its establishment in 1971, TICRA has built a strong reputation for technical excellence and deep expertise in electromagnetic modeling and antenna engineering.
